vouchers.tc: Discount is only available to selected users in Hong Kong. Discount is valid till 31 Jul, 2026 from the date of issuance. Each user is allowed to order and use this discount once only. Discount is only applicable to all bookings on Klook platforms for hotels booking only. Upon net spending of HK$1,500 discount is capped at HK$200 for each order. Limited quota is available for this discount and is on a first-come-first-served basis. Discount will be available when it reaches redemption quota or usage limit. Code will not be reissued in such circumstances. If users cannot receive a discount or promotion code for any reason, the code will not be reissued. Discount can only be applied at checkout on Klook platforms. In the cases of users failing to check out with discount or respective promotion codes, users cannot claim the discount after booking confirmation. No refunds, exchanges or adjustments will be made. Discount is non-transferable or exchanged for cash or any assets from Klook. Discount cannot be used in conjunction with other Klook?s promotion codes.  Klook reserves the right to vary conditions of use of the discount or respective coupon codes to withdraw the discount or coupon codes at any time.  In case of any disputes, Klook reserves the right of final decision. Terms and conditions apply.
